prompt_template.poliza: Extract the policy number shown near the insurer header (QUÁLITAS/Qualitas). Look for labels like "Póliza", "No. de Póliza", "N° Póliza", "Póliza No.". Return only the digits (remove spaces, dots, or hyphens). If multiple, choose the one in the main policy summary, not endorsements.
prompt_template.inicioPeriodoVigencia: Extract the start of coverage from the "Vigencia" line. Look for "Vigencia", "Inicio de vigencia", or "Del/Desde" followed by a date (often dd/mm/aaaa and possibly a time like "12:00 hrs"). Convert to Unix timestamp in seconds using America/Mexico_City timezone; if a time is printed, use it, otherwise default to 00:00. Return as a numeric string (e.g., "1666545600").
prompt_template.finalPeriodoVigencia: Extract the end of coverage from the "Vigencia" line. Look for "Hasta/Al" or "Fin de vigencia" date. Convert to Unix timestamp in seconds using America/Mexico_City timezone; if a time is printed, use it, otherwise default to 23:59:59 of that date. Return as a numeric string.
prompt_template.aseguradora: Extract the insurer name from the document header or footer. For this template, when the brand "QUÁLITAS" / "Qualitas" appears, return "QUÁLITAS" in uppercase. If a full legal name appears (e.g., "Quálitas Compañía de Seguros, S.A. de C.V."), prefer the brand form "QUÁLITAS".
prompt_template.ramo: Extract the line labeled "Ramo". If not explicitly present but the document clearly refers to auto insurance (presence of VIN/NIV, placas, modelo), set to "AUTOS". Otherwise, return empty string.
prompt_template.subRamo: Extract the line labeled "Subramo" or "Sub-ramo" (e.g., "Automóviles Residentes"). If not present, return empty string.
prompt_template.cobertura: Extract the coverage type near the policy summary: look for "Cobertura" and values like "Amplia", "Limitada", "Responsabilidad Civil", "RC", "RC Obligatoria". Return the exact term found (uppercase it). If not present, return empty string.
prompt_template.formaDePago: Extract from "Forma de pago" / "Forma de Pago" / "Plan de pagos". Normalize to uppercase single term such as CONTADO, MENSUAL, SEMESTRAL, ANUAL, FRACCIONADO, TDC, DOMICILIACIÓN. If multiple words, keep them as printed (uppercase).
prompt_template.primaNeta: Extract the amount labeled "Prima Neta". Return only the numeric amount: remove currency symbols and spaces, keep the minus sign if any, use comma as thousands separator and dot as decimal separator with two decimals (e.g., 11,557.97).
prompt_template.primerPago: Extract the amount labeled "Primer pago" / "Pago inicial". Return only the numeric amount with two decimals; remove currency symbols, keep sign, use comma thousands and dot decimal.
prompt_template.pagoPosterior: Extract the amount labeled "Pago posterior", "Pagos posteriores", or "Pago subsecuente(s)". If not applicable (e.g., forma de pago CONTADO), return "0". Return only the numeric amount with two decimals; remove currency symbols, keep sign, use comma thousands and dot decimal.
prompt_template.descuento: Extract the amount labeled "Descuento" or "Bonificación" within the premium breakdown. Return only the numeric amount with two decimals; if not present, return "0".
prompt_template.iva: Extract the tax amount labeled exactly "IVA" (not the rate like 16%). Return only the numeric amount with two decimals; remove currency symbols, keep sign, use comma thousands and dot decimal.
prompt_template.tasaFinanciamiento: Extract the amount labeled "Tasa de financiamiento", "Interés", or financing-related adjustment in the premium breakdown. It may be negative. Return only the numeric amount with two decimals (preserve minus if present); remove currency symbols; use comma thousands and dot decimal.
prompt_template.derechoPoliza: Extract the fee labeled "Derecho de póliza", "Derechos de póliza", or "Derechos" (when clearly referring to policy issuance fees). Return only the numeric amount with two decimals; if not present, return "0".
prompt_template.total: Extract the overall "Total" to pay for the policy premium (look for "Total a pagar", "Importe total"). Do not take totals from sums insured or valuation sections. Return only the numeric amount with two decimals; remove currency symbols; use comma thousands and dot decimal.
prompt_template.cargoPorFinanciamiento: Extract the line labeled "Cargo por financiamiento" / "Cargo financiamiento" / "Financiamiento" distinct from interest rate labels. Return only the numeric amount with two decimals (preserve minus if present). If not present, return "0".
prompt_template.rfcAsegurado: Extract the insured's RFC labeled "RFC del Asegurado" or near the insured data block. Validate format: 12 or 13 characters matching [A-Z&Ñ]{3,4}[0-9]{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}. Return in uppercase without spaces.
prompt_template.nombreAsegurado: Extract the full name labeled "Asegurado". If both "Asegurado" and "Contratante" appear, prefer "Asegurado"; if only "Contratante" appears, use that. Return as printed in uppercase, without extra labels or punctuation.
prompt_template.numeroSerie: Extract the vehicle serial number (VIN/NIV) labeled "Número de serie", "Núm. de serie", "NIV", or "VIN". Return the 17-character alphanumeric code (exclude I, O, Q if OCR noise appears); uppercase, no spaces.
prompt_template.modelo: Extract the vehicle model year labeled "Modelo" or "Año". Return the 4-digit year (e.g., 2017).
prompt_template.numeroPlacas: Extract vehicle plates labeled "Placas" or "Matrícula". Return the exact alphanumeric value without spaces around it.
prompt_template.adaptaciones: Extract "Adaptaciones" / "Equipo especial" / "Convertido" details if present; otherwise return empty string. Return the text exactly as printed (truncate leading/trailing spaces).
prompt_template.version: Extract vehicle version/clave labeled "Versión", "Clave", or "Clave vehicular" near model/serie data. Return the code or text as printed (e.g., 02134).
prompt_template.beneficiarioPreferente: Extract the preferred beneficiary/lienholder labeled "Beneficiario preferente", "Acreedor prendario", or "Beneficiario" under vehicle/coverage section. Return the full legal name; if none, return empty string.
